  tenant_id: String(p.tenant_id),

  execution_id: String(p.execution_id),
  trigger_message_id: String(p.trigger_message_id),
  idempotency_key: String(p.idempotency_key),
  plan_id: String(p.plan_id),
  goal: String(p.goal),
  primary_intent: String(p.primary_intent),

parameters.query:
SELECT
  ec.id::text AS execution_id,
  ec.tenant_id::text AS tenant_id,
  ec.thread_id::text AS thread_id,
  ec.trigger_message_id::text AS trigger_message_id,
  ec.idempotency_key,
  ec.status
FROM public.execution_contexts ec
WHERE ec.id = '{{ $("DI_Extract_Dispatch_Input").first().json.execution_id }}'::uuid
  AND ec.tenant_id = '{{ $("DI_Extract_Dispatch_Input").first().json.tenant_id }}'::uuid
  AND ec.thread_id = '{{ $("DI_Extract_Dispatch_Input").first().json.thread_id }}'::uuid
LIMIT 1;
